method FizzBuzz(n: int) returns (count: int)
    requires n >= 0
    ensures count == CountSevensInDivisibles(n)

method CountSevensInDivisibles(n: int) returns (count: int)
    requires n >= 0
    ensures count == |{ x: int | 0 <= x < n && (x % 11 == 0 || x % 13 == 0) && ContainsSeven(x) }|

    requires x >= 0
    ensures result == (CountDigitSeven(x) > 0)

method CountDigitSeven(x: int) returns (count: int)
    requires x >= 0
    ensures count >= 0
    ensures count == |{ d: int | d is a digit of x && d == 7 }|
